items.title: Could the A.I. Buildout Crash the Economy?
items.author: Ryan Reed
items.content: Economists expect the A.I. buildout to be the biggest industrial capital expenditure boom in all of American history.

items.title: Don’t Get in Hot Water: New Disclosure Document From TREC
items.author: Ryan Reed
items.content: With water demand on the rise, sellers and agents need to be aware of a new disclosure document related to groundwater and surface water rights.

items.title: Do Dead Malls Have Game?
items.author: Aliza Abidi
items.content: Two Dallas sports franchises could give new purpose to two aging shopping malls. But first they’ll have to clear some hurdles.
